subject: Cloud seller terms & partner-paper: redlines + sequencing
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: marketplace-legal@stratusmarket.com, sarah.jennings@stratusmarket.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud seller terms & partner-paper: redlines + sequencing

Hi Sarah / Marketplace Legal team,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week — excited about the StratusMarket listing. Attached are three files: a redlined MSA (v3), an order form with seller flow language highlighted, and the partner paper with inline comments. Key asks from Redwood:

- We need the marketplace pass-through fee language clarified so it does not create duplicate invoicing risk. Our preference: Stratus collects marketplace fees and remits net amounts to Redwood; Redwood will not bill end customers for the same fee.
- Data residency & audit log carveouts: we can accept customer-restricted logs but need a 30-day buffer for diagnostic retention on deduplicated telemetry.
- Procurement / DocuSign sequencing: please confirm whether Stratus will execute the marketplace addendum first or the order form. We prefer order form execution after the partner-paper is finalized to avoid misaligned commercial terms.

Would you confirm a target turnaround for consolidated redlines? We are aiming to finalize before May 3 so the listing launch stays on schedule.

Attachments: Redline_MSA_Stratus_v3.docx; OrderForm_SellerFlow_Redline.xlsx; PartnerPaper_Stratus_comments.pdf

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0183

Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform

From: marketplace-legal@stratusmarket.com
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sarah.jennings@stratusmarket.com, procurement@stratusmarket.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud seller terms & partner-paper: redlines + sequencing

Laura —

Thanks for sending the redlines and the clear note. Quick responses to the three bullets:

1) Pass-through fee / double-billing: we generally require the marketplace to be listed as the billing party for marketplace-levied fees but can add a warranty/representation from the seller that no duplicate fees will be charged. Need your legal to accept the following compromise: a one-line covenant in the Order Form ("Seller will not separately invoice any marketplace transaction fee charged by StratusMarket for the same transaction"). Will that satisfy Redwood?

2) Diagnostic retention: 30-day buffer sounds reasonable; procurement wants a sentence limiting retention to aggregated telemetry where feasible.

3) Sequencing: our standard is execute Partner Paper (partner terms) + Order Form contemporaneously; MSA can follow in parallel, but Procurement typically needs the fully-executed Order Form to set up revenue pass-through. If Redwood insists on Order Form signing after partner-paper, Procurement can accommodate if you confirm on timeline.

We had a quick look at the MSA redline — several of your edits are substantive (indemnity, limitation caps, and KYC flow). We'll consolidate and propose a single redline for execution. Expect a consolidated response by Tue, Apr 13 EOD Pacific.

On a practical note: please confirm the primary contact for DocuSign routing (individual + email) so we can prepare envelopes on our side.

Best,
Stratus Marketplace Legal (on behalf of Sarah Jennings)
marketplace-legal@stratusmarket.com

From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: marketplace-legal@stratusmarket.com, sarah.jennings@stratusmarket.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:49:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud seller terms & partner-paper: redlines + sequencing

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of internal notes and proposed language to help speed up consolidation:

Jonas (Legal) / Vanessa (Sales ops) — please see the points from Stratus below. My recommendation: accept the one-line covenant on duplicate fees, but push to add an explicit remittance timing (Stratus will remit net proceeds to Redwood within 45 days of settlement) and a reconciliation right (quarterly, 60-day claim window).

Proposed Order Form covenant (for consolidated redline):
"Seller shall not separately invoice any marketplace transaction fee charged by StratusMarket for the same transaction. StratusMarket will remit net transaction proceeds to Seller within forty-five (45) days following settlement, and Seller will have the right to request reconciliation with supporting transaction logs within sixty (60) days of remittance."

On diagnostic retention: we can accept the aggregated telemetry sentence, provided we retain a 30-day raw buffer for internal diagnostics and breach investigation. Suggested addition in the MSA: "Notwithstanding aggregation requirements, Seller may retain non-identifying diagnostic logs for thirty (30) days for operational debugging and security investigations."

DocuSign routing: route to laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com for Partner Paper and Order Form; route MSA to contracts@redwoodinference.com (Contracts team will countersign).

Vanessa — can you confirm that the sales order form templates tolerate the covenant and the remittance timing? If not, flag now so legal can work around the template constraints.

Thanks,
Laura

On a housekeeping note: I uploaded an editable redline in Drive — link in the header. If Stratus wants to work in Word change-tracking instead, we can do that too.

From: sarah.jennings@stratusmarket.com
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marketplace-legal@stratusmarket.com, procurement@stratusmarket.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud seller terms & partner-paper: redlines + sequencing

Laura / team —

We're aligned with the proposed compromise and the remittance timeline; Procurement has confirmed the 45-day remit is operationally feasible. We'll accept the reconciliation window and the 30-day diagnostic buffer as proposed, subject to one small edit in the MSA: change "non-identifying diagnostic logs" to "aggregated, non-individually-identifiable diagnostic logs" to be explicit.

We'll push a consolidated redline (MSA + Order Form + Partner Paper) into the Drive folder and aim to circulate for signatures by Wed, Apr 14. Please confirm final DocuSign recipients so Procurement can create envelopes the same day.

Thanks and excited to launch —
Sarah Jennings
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, StratusMarket
sarah.jennings@stratusmarket.com
Attachments referenced: consolidated_redline_v1.zip (contains merged Word/PDF redlines)
